title: Periodic Table & Periodicity
notes: **Modern periodic law:** properties of elements are a periodic function of their atomic numbers. The long form of the periodic table has 7 periods and 18 groups.

**Periodic trends:**
- **Atomic radius** decreases across a period (increasing nuclear charge) and increases down a group (new shells added).
- **Ionisation energy** increases across a period, decreases down a group.
- **Electronegativity** increases across a period, decreases down a group.
- **Electron affinity** generally increases across a period.
- **Metallic character** decreases across a period and increases down a group.
**Anomalies:** Be > B and N > O in ionisation energy due to extra stability of fully/half-filled sub-shells (1s², 2s², 2p³).
**Diagonal relationship:** elements of period 2 (Li–Mg, Be–Al, B–Si) resemble the diagonal element of period 3 in properties.
